name: CCA 321 积冰/防冰 乘客医疗 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CCA 321, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 1100 meters, squawking 3120, your captain suffered from cardiac arrest and became incapacitated, make a distress call with Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CCA 321，这是一趟从北京飞往广州的航班，正保持 1100 米，应答机 3120，机长心脏骤停并失能，向广州管制发出遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Guangzhou Control, CCA 321, maintaining 1100 meters, 10100 meters squawking 3120, our captain suffered from cardiac arrest and became incapacitated.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，广州管制，CCA 321，正保持 1100 米，10100 米，应答机 3120，我们的机长心脏骤停并失能。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 321, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, roger MAYDAY, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller to stand by and you are checking if there is a doctor on board.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 321，广州管制，雷达识别，收到 MAYDAY，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员稍等，你正在查看机上是否有医生。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, we are checking if there is a doctor on board, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，我们正在查看机上是否有医生，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: B: The purser found a doctor on board and offered CPR procedures to revive the captain, but the captain is having difficulty in breathing, inform Guangzhou Control about the situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 乘务长在机上找到一名医生，并进行 CPR 试图抢救机长，但机长呼吸困难，向广州管制通报情况。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA 321, the purser found a doctor on board and offered CPR procedures to revive the captain, but the captain is having difficulty in breathing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA 321，乘务长在机上找到一名医生并进行 CPR 试图抢救机长，但机长呼吸困难。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 321, when able, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller that you'd like to divert to Wuhan and you need physician and first aid upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 321，可以时说明意图。
B: 告诉管制员你想改航 Wuhan，并且着陆时需要医生和急救。
cards.referenceText: Request divert to Wuhan and request a physician and first aid upon landing, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求改航 Wuhan，并请求着陆时提供医生和急救，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 321, roger, turn right, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 321，收到，右转，直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，联系武汉进近119.35。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, 119.35, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，119.35，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6000 meters, inform your situation to Wuhan Approach and request priority landing and medical services.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 ZF 上空，保持 6000 米，向武汉进近说明情况并请求优先着陆和医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CCA 321, over ZF, maintaining 6000 meters, our captain got incapacitated, he is having difficulty in breathing, request priority landing and medical services.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉进近，CCA 321，过 ZF，保持 6000 米，我们的机长失能，他呼吸困难，请求优先着陆和医疗服务。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, follow ZF-02A arrival, descend to 4,200 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，执行 ZF-02A 进场，下降至 4,200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: follow ZF02 A Arrival, descend to 4200 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-02A 进场，下降至 4200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 321, descend to 2400 meters, turn right heading 350, reduce speed to 240 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 321，下降到 2400 米，右转航向 350，减速到 240 节。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2400 meters, turn right heading 350, reduce speed to 240 knots, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 2400 米，右转航向 350，减速到 240 节，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，下降至 900 米，右转航向 330，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS Runway 36R, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 900 米，右转航向 330，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 321, established on ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 321，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, continue approach Runway 36R, surface wind 350 degrees, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，继续进近 Runway 36R，地面风向 350 度，风速 3 米/秒。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, Runway 36R, cleared to land, surface wind 340 degrees, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，Runway 36R，许可落地，地面风向 340 度，风速 3 米/秒。

cards.audioText: B: During final approach, you find the ILS area is not clear and you are going around, inform Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 最后进近中，你发现 ILS 区域未净空，正在复飞，通知 武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 321, ILS area is not clear, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 321，ILS 区域未净空，复飞。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, my apologies for that, follow the standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1,500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，对此我很抱歉，执行标准复飞程序，爬升至 1,500 米，联系武汉进近 119.35。
cards.referenceText: follow the standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.35, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉进近 119.35，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: now you have vacated the Runway 36R, tell the controller you need a follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已脱离 Runway 36R，告诉管制员你需要一辆引导车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 321, Runway 36R vacated, request a follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 321，已脱离 Runway 36R，请求一辆引导车。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 321, hold position, the follow-me car is on the way for you.
B: Tell the controller you have seen the follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CCA 321，保持位置，引导车正在赶来。
B： 告诉管制员你已看到引导车。
cards.referenceText: hold position, follow-me car in sight, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持位置，已看到引导车，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, follow the follow-me car to gate 557 via taxiway T4 and D.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，跟随引导车经 T4 和 D 滑行道前往 557 登机口。
cards.referenceText: follow the follow-me car to gate 557 via taxiway T four and DAL, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随引导车经 T4 和 DAL 滑行道前往 557 登机口，CCA 321。
